data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name Laurus, meaning 'laurel'. In ancient Rome, laurel was a symbol of victory and honor. Lauraine may evoke images of triumph and success. The name Lauraine carries the meaning “Little Laurel” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lauraine usually hope their child will grow to embody little laurel and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: לעורין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: לעורין היא התארגמנות לשם לורן, שמשמעותה 'פרח' או 'תפארת', שהוא שם האדם שניתן בברית החדשה. שם זה מקורו בלטינית, וזהו שם עברי שנבע מן העת העתיקה. השם 'לעורין' נפוץ בקרב הקהילות הנוצריות, והוא נחשב לשם עתיק ואוהד.

in_greek.name: Λαουραίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Λαουραίνη είναι η μετάφραση του ονόματος Λορέν, που σημαίνει 'λαμπρό' ή 'απλό'. Αυτό το όνομα προέρχεται από την λατινική γλώσσα και είναι ένα από τα παλαιότερα ονόματα που χρησιμοποιήθηκαν στην πίστη των Χριστιανών. Η Λουραίνη θεωρείται ένα όνομα αξιόπιστο και παλιό, που έχει ιστορία και μυστήριο.

in_latin.name: Lauraine
in_latin.long_meaning: Lauraine est nomen originis Laurentii, quod significat 'lumen' aut 'ornatus'. Hoc nomen ex lingua Latina oriundum est et est unus ex antiquissimis nominibus, qui in Ecclesia Christiana fuerunt. Lauraine est nomen antiquum et vere Christi fidelium.

in_english.name: Lauraine
in_english.long_meaning: Lauraine is the English adaptation of the name Lauren, meaning 'laurel tree' or 'praise'. This name originated from the Latin language and is one of the earliest names used in the Christian faith. Lauraine is considered a faithful and ancient name with historical and mystical significance. It is often associated with qualities of nobility and dignity, making it a popular choice for Christian parents seeking a meaningful and elegant name for their child. In modern times, Lauraine has become a popular variant of the name Lauren, with many parents choosing it for its unique and classic sound.
